title: Tune FTS matching: OR-mode and stop-word handling for ironmem search
prompt: Issue #95: The FTS5 implicit-AND mode makes verbose NL prompts rarely fire. Implement OR-mode matching or stop-word stripping so that natural-language recall queries hit relevant memory entries. See PR #112 notes on FTS5 implicit-AND.
acceptance: ironmem search returns results for multi-word queries that previously returned nothing
at least one new test covers the OR/stop-word scenario

title: collab-plans drawers pollute default keyword recall — scope collab FTS
prompt: Issue #96 (follow-up from PR #116 plan-by-reference): collab-plans drawers pollute default keyword recall via FTS. Scope collab content out of default search or add a filter so generic keyword queries don't surface collab planning artifacts.
acceptance: default ironmem search no longer returns collab-plan artifacts unless explicitly requested

title: AGENTS.md paraphrase + shared atomic_write follow-up from PR #115
prompt: Issue #98 (follow-up from PR #115 write-rules): update AGENTS.md with a paraphrase of the new write-rules protocol; extract the shared atomic_write helper so it is not duplicated across modules.
acceptance: atomic_write is a shared helper with no duplication

title: Add measured rerank rows to METRICS_SPEC §10.4 headline query
prompt: The rerank/pref measured rows were deliberately left off the §10.4 headline query (deferred from PR #113). Add them: wire rerank and preference-extraction token usage into the existing token_usage table joins and report them in ironmem report --json output.
acceptance: ironmem report --json includes rerank and pref-extract token rows

title: Prevent collab-plans from appearing in default FTS search results
prompt: collab-plans drawers written by the plan-by-reference feature (PR #116) surface in generic keyword recall. Add a room/tag filter or FTS virtual table partition so collab plans are excluded from the default search path but still findable via explicit room filter.
acceptance: generic keyword search excludes collab-plan drawers by default
explicit room=collab-plans search still returns them

title: Replace process-local generation cache with persistent actor-generation tracking
prompt: PR #117 shipped a process-local generation cache for session_handoff. Make actor generations persistent (survive process restart) by storing them in the collab_actor_generations table already migrated in schema v10. Remove the in-process HashMap.
acceptance: collab_actor_generations table is the source of truth

title: Incremental code-map refresh: re-scout only changed_files on Stale verdict
prompt: When code_map_load returns Stale with changed_files, the worker must re-read only those files and call code_map_write to refresh. Add a helper or runner that automates this incremental refresh step so workers don't have to manually iterate changed_files.
acceptance: code_map_load Stale verdict triggers automated incremental refresh via helper
only changed_files are re-read (not all source files)
tests cover the incremental vs full-rescan distinction

title: Verify 3-file doc lockstep for occupancy thresholds after PR #119
prompt: PR #119 shipped occupancy thresholds (WARN 0.60 / HANDOFF 0.80) with a 3-file doc lockstep requirement. Audit that COLLAB.md, METRICS_SPEC.md, and the crate source all agree on the threshold values and the handoff trigger semantics. Fix any divergence.
acceptance: COLLAB.md, METRICS_SPEC.md, and source all agree on 0.60/0.80 thresholds
